verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Stripe publishes its own API reference for invoices, with endpoint listings at docs.stripe.com/api/invoices, plus a quickstart for building a full, working invoicing integration. Nothing in the pack shows the reference is interactive or that its examples can be run in place, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404s. missing for 10: evidence of an interactive API explorer, runnable in-reference examples, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: Build a full, working invoicing integration using Stripe Invoicing.
